description: The drawer header starts a new conversation at 390px. The screen is already 390x800 (do not resize it). A conversation exists at /c/{{SLUG}}. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Click the button "Open conversations". 3. The drawer header's actions hold exactly four rendered buttons, in order "Search conversations...", "View options", "New Conversation" and "Close conversations": eval JSON.stringify([...document.querySelectorAll('.drawer-header-actions button')].filter(b => b.checkVisibility({visibilityProperty: true})).map(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label'))) must return exactly ["Search conversations...","View options","New Conversation","Close conversations"]. 4. Click the button "New Conversation" inside ".drawer-header-actions". 5. The URL's path should become exactly /new: poll eval "location.pathname" expecting "/new". 6. The message input (data-testid "message-input") should be empty. 7. The drawer (".drawer") must not have the class "open".
